History_of_Present_Illness.content: Patient has a 4-day history of feeling generally unwell with symptoms including sore throat, runny nose, fatigue, myalgia, and general joint pain.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: 4/7 hx of generally unwell, mainly sore throat, runny nose, fatigue, myalgia and general joint pain.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: The sore throat is improving and the patient also has nasal congestion.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Sore throat is improving. Also has nasal congestion.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Patient has now developed a mainly dry and constant cough.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Now developed a cough -mainly dry, constant.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Patient has been experiencing night sweats for the past 4 days.
There was an initial fever which is now settling with paracetamol/ibuprofen.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Initially had fever, but now settling with paracetamol/ibuprofen.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Patient denies chest pain but feels more short of breath on exertion.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: No chest pain. Feels more SOB on exertion.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Associated symptoms include generalized, intermittent headaches.
Patient denies visual symptoms, photophobia, nausea, vomiting, or ear discharge.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: No visual sx/photophobia. No nausea/vomiting. No ear discharge.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: There are no bowel or urinary symptoms, and no rashes.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: No bowel or urinary sx... No rashes

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Patient is drinking fluids but has a reduced appetite.

Past_Medical_History.content: Patient has no significant past medical history.

Adverse_Drug_Reactions_and_Allergies.content: Patient has no known drug allergies.

Social_and_Family_History.content: Patient lives alone and works as an accountant.
Social_and_Family_History.source_text: SH: lives alone, works as an accountant.

Social_and_Family_History.content: Patient is an occasional smoker and alcohol consumer.
Patient finds work slightly stressful but reports no mood symptoms.
Social_and_Family_History.source_text: Finding work slightly stressful. No mood sx.

Assessment.content: The impression is a viral upper respiratory tract infection (URTI) or influenza.

Plan_of_Care.content: Advised conservative management including rest, increased fluid intake, regular paracetamol/ibuprofen, and temperature monitoring.
Plan_of_Care.source_text: Conservative mx - rest, push fluids, regular paracetamol/ibuprofen, monitor temp

Follow_up_Information.content: Patient to have a review in 5-7 days if not better.
Red flag symptoms (shortness of breath, chest pain, fevers) were discussed, and patient was advised to seek urgent review if they occur.
